import requests
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
import pytest

EXPECTED_SYMPTOM = {
    "exception_type": "ConnectTimeout",
    "message_regex": "Connection timed out",
    "description": "Negative control: Timeout reported ignored in stream download",
    "target_symbols": ["requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter.send"],
}

def test_reproduce_issue(monkeypatch):
    s = requests.Session()
    adapter = requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter()
    adapter.send = MagicMock(return_value=requests.Response())
    s.mount('http://', adapter)
    resp = s.get('http://example.com', timeout=2.5)
    assert resp is not None
    assert adapter.send.call_args[1]['timeout'] == 2.5
